orientation: A.2 defines the Sky Primitives — the reusable machinery by which Agents are created, funded, paid and wound down — plus the Ecosystem Accords with counterparties and the shared services (forum, legal resilience, bug bounty) the ecosystem runs centrally. Its recurring shape is capability declared ahead of the process that would make it usable: Accords whose terms are deferred while capital is authorized, a Resilience Fund whose claim protocol is undefined, and eligibility bars strict enough to defeat the capability they secure.
